entries.specification: 1. `y11-villus-cutaway-v1.png` (about 1200 x 1800, portrait): one intestinal villus standing upright, cut lengthways down its middle so its inside shows. A small arteriole and venule and the lacteal leave at the base. Space above and around the tip stays clear for coded dots.

entries.specification: 1. `y11-hypothalamus-pituitary-section-v1.png` (about 1600 x 2000, portrait): an enlarged cutaway of the base of the brain, matching the brain plate's colours. Top third: a band of pale pink hypothalamus tissue (cropped cleanly at the top and sides as a section, not a whole brain), containing two clusters of slightly larger nerve cell bodies (round, purple nuclei) towards the right and a row of small nerve cell endings along its lower edge towards the left. Middle: a narrow stalk running down from it. Bottom: the pituitary, clearly two lobes side by side: the front lobe at the left, larger, darker pink and glandular (small rounded cells), the back lobe at the right, paler and fibrous. A fine red network of small blood vessels starts as capillary loops at the base of the hypothalamus on the left, runs down the left side of the stalk as two or three parallel vessels, and spreads into a second capillary network through the front lobe. Fine pale nerve fibres run from the right-hand nerve cell clusters straight down the right side of the stalk and end in small swellings inside the back lobe. No dots, granules or arrows (the build adds them). No bone, no skull.

entries.specification: 1. `y11-villus-cutaway-v1.png` (about 1200 x 1800, portrait): one intestinal villus standing upright, cut lengthways down its middle so its inside shows. Its outer surface is a single layer of tall columnar epithelial cells (each with a visible nucleus near its base and a fine fringe along its top edge for the brush border), with one or two goblet cells among them. Inside: a dense branching capillary network (red arterial side, blue venous side, joined in loops just under the epithelium) and one pale cream central lacteal running from near the tip down to the base, blind-ended at the top. A small arteriole and venule and the lacteal leave at the base. Space above and around the tip stays clear for coded dots.
